name: Hanselewirt
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Hanselewirt in Schwangau**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, just a stone’s throw from the majestic **Neuschwanstein Castle**, the **Hanselewirt** invites you to experience authentic Bavarian hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting.

Our traditional **Tiroler** inn offers a warm atmosphere where you can savor classic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork), and fresh **Obazda** with pretzels. Pair your meal with a crisp **Helles** or a smooth **Weißbier** from the region.

After a day of exploring the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol** or the fairy-tale charm of **Innsbruck**, unwind in our sunlit beer garden or by the crackling fireplace. Whether you’re seeking relaxation or a lively gathering, the **Hanselewirt** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Schwangau**.

**Come, enjoy the good life—Bavarian style!**
